patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce and SAP Customer Experience share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Salesforce only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and ” rather than SAP Customer Experience's shape. Choose SAP Customer Experience only if your buying job matches “SAP Customer Experience / Sales Cloud; custom enterprise quote only.” rather than Salesforce's shape. Workflow advantage: Salesforce leans outbound-sales; SAP Customer Experience leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce and SAP Customer Experience share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Salesforce is Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and mid-market teams.; SAP Customer Experience is SAP Customer Experience / Sales Cloud; custom enterprise quote only..
- Company-size focus: Salesforce (mid-market, enterprise) vs SAP Customer Experience (enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Salesforce-leaning outbound-sales vs SAP Customer Experience-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Salesforce — USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; SAP Customer Experience — Custom quote only.

Limitations — Salesforce: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; Premier Support is an add-on on Pro Suite. Agentforce for Sales, Sales Programs, Revenue Intelligence, and Revenue Cloud are separate paid add-ons; some require Contact us.; SAP Customer Experience: Custom quote only; High implementation overhead.

Poor-fit cases: Salesforce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO. · SAP Customer Experience is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom quote only · Avoid Salesforce if you actually need SAP Customer Experience's motion (SAP Customer Experience / Sales Cloud; custom enterprise quote only.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
